programme.title: XIII: The Conspiracy
programme.desc: Ross Tanner successfully deals with his multiple identity mystery and the terrorist threats as well as a top-level conspiracy including the White House chief of staff, which La Mangouste fails to protect against him. Wally Sheridan is elected instead of president Galbraith, who thanks him and general Carrington. Yet 'XIII' senses something isn't right.

programme.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
programme.desc: In the late 1880's, a widowed mother of three struggles to keep her family intact and to put food on the table. The oldest daughter sends a letter to her estranged, very wealthy grandmother urging her assistance, much to her mother's disapproval. When the grandmother arrives, old wounds are opened but eventually healed. From a story by Louisa May Alcott. Stars Jacqueline Bisset, Ted Atherton, Tatiana Maslany, Helene Joy, Paula Boudreau, and Michael Barbuto.

programme.title: Tin Man
programme.desc: After a storm sent by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia, DG manages to escape her small town and finds herself in the dangerous underworld know as the O.Z. There she befriends three of its inhabitants: Glitch, Wyatt Cain and Raw and meets the great Mystic Man. They all help her escape from the evil sorceress who's after her.

programme.title: The Lion in Winter
programme.desc: King Henry II meets with Eleanor of Aquitaine at Christmastide 1183 to choose one of his sons as his successor.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: Drama mini-series that combines gothic horror with science-fiction. Alec Newman stars as Dr Victor Frankenstein: a talented and ambitious doctor who creates life but goes on to reject the creature he has produced. Luke Goss stars as one of literature's most famous monsters who seeks vengeance on his unsympathetic creator. Frankenstein is an adaptation of Mary Shelley's classic tale that explores themes of birth, creation, ambition, alienation and revenge. Also starring Nicole Lewis, Dan Stevens and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Mystery spy thriller about a housewife who leads a double life as an undercover government agent. When a major arms dealer stages an ingenious escape froman LA prison and sets out on a mission of vengeance, Jane Doe faces a race against time to protect the intended victim.

programme.title: Jane Doe: The Wrong Face
programme.desc: Mystery thriller about Cathy Davis (Lea Thompson, 'Back to the Future'), a housewife and mother who leads a double life as a government agent. Despite having retired from undercover work, Cathy is called back into service when the wife of a prominent lawyer is kidnapped. She soon finds herself facing one of the most baffling puzzles of her career.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Yes, I Remember It Well
programme.desc: Mystery drama about a housewife who leads a double life as a government agent. Jane Doe has to find a missing British agent who has knowledge of the names and addresses of every UK operative in the Middle East. Was the man kidnapped, or did he arrange his own disappearance?

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Teens (aka She's Too Young)
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.title: Too Late to Say Goodbye
programme.desc: Bart Corbin's wife Jenn dies in their home, apparently suicide, as the police believes. While he moves in with young sons Taylor and Trevor at brother Bobby's, her sister Heather starts a relentless campaign, without any clue, to make the police believe Bart must have murdered her and had an affair with practice secretary Dara.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: The Society Murders
programme.desc: The Society Murders was the name given to the April 4, 2002 murders of husband and wife millionaire socialites Margaret Mary Wales-King, 69, and husband, Paul Aloysius King, 75 in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, by their son, Matthew Wales. The crime and subsequent trial received widespread media coverage throughout Australia and later became the subject of both a book and a television film.

programme.title: Jane Doe: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: Frank Darnell, director of the Central Security Agency (CSA), is at a loss when Miles Crandall, the genius who writes top-secret satellite communication software for his Pentagon-contracted company, disappears from a private jet flight, apparently by parachute, over the desert. CSA vet Cathy Davis, who retired to be a mother to husband Jack ad their kids, is secretly called in to solve the riddle, ironic given her cover as game designer for the US Puzzle Co. They soon realize the escape was staged, the question remains by whom and why. Meanwhile, Nick an unpopular bright nerd runs for class secretary, his haughty sister Susan fails to join the cheerleaders.

programme.title: Replacing Dad
programme.desc: Linda and George live in a small town. He is the school principal. They are about to celebrate their 16th anniversary. She catches him with her daughter's young teacher, and has to deal with the kids, the town and her love to him.

programme.title: Hard Ground
programme.desc: Billy Bucklin escapes while being transported to Yuma prison and plans to form an army of desperadoes to control the Mexican border. To finance his band, he robs a stagecoach, kidnaps a beautiful woman to be sold into prostitution, and steals an army payroll wagon. An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: Hidden Places
programme.desc: When Eliza (Sydney Penny) loses her father-in-law she is left to raise two children, continue work on an unharvested orange crop, and maintain a heavy mortgage. She begins to lose faith until her Aunt Batty (Shirley Jones) persuades her to persevere. Suddenly a mysterious stranger called Gabe (Jason Gedrick) turns up and helps Eliza with the harvest just in time to stop the bank from taking over. The more Eliza learns about Gabe, the more she realizes she loves him.

programme.title: Jack
programme.desc: Jack, in full puberty, not only has to deal with his parents' divorce, but also feels his world is falling apart when his dad tells him he is living with a man. He slowly comes to terms with his own feelings when the girl he has a crush on turn out to have a gay dad as well and his best friend's parents end up not having the perfect marriage Jack thought they had.

programme.title: Gentle Ben: Terror On The Mountain
programme.desc: When Mark goes for a visit with his uncle he's thrown into a world he knows not much about. Little does he know it'll be a world he's going to have to become very familiar with. One character Mark becomes very familiar and friendly with is a very tame black bear who he later names Ben.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: Drama, with Dean Cain. Ranger Jack finds himself in prison after butting heads with Fog, who plans to drill for oil in his reserve, leaving Ben and Mark to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Accidental Friendship
programme.desc: Life-affirming drama based on a true story. Following a chance encounter, a female police officer befriends a down-and-out who has lost everything but her dogs and is now living rough on the streets of Los Angeles. This unlikely friendship lasts a number of years, during which time the cop finds love and the homeless woman (Chandra Wilson, ʻGreyʼs Anatomyʼ) is encouraged to make a new start in life.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy
programme.desc: John William "Will" Cooper is a modern-day rancher, maintaining his ranch in hard times along with his friend and foreman Amos Russell. When Will's estranged daughter Jake returns to the ranch for her grandfather's funeral, father and daughter clash over how to run the ranch and over the death years before of Jake's mother, which she blames on Will. Crisis comes in the form of insurmountable debt, and it is only by working together that Will and Jake have any chance of saving their home and their family.

programme.title: Jasper, Texas
programme.desc: In 1998, three white men in the small town of Jasper, Texas, chained a black man to the back of their pickup truck and dragged him to his death. This film relates that story and how it affected all of the residents of the town, both black and white.

programme.title: Teens (aka She's Too Young)
programme.desc: The film showcases three 14-year-old girls: Dawn (Miriam McDonald), Becca (Megan Park), and Hannah (Alexis Dziena). Hannah soon finds herself on the receiving end of peer pressure from her friends to engage in oral sex with Nick Hartman, a nice boy whom Hannah likes. She believes that she has to behave in a particular fashion in order to fit in with her more sexually-active peers.

programme.desc: Twelve years after the emperor's death, the Fremen armies have successfully subdued all known planets, killing off millions in numerous battles. The desert plant Arrakis "Dune" has become an imperial capital, still thanks to its monopoly on the spice. Now Paul Muad'Dib Atreidis' son and daughter are coming of age, the stage is set for a new power game. The spice guilt has prepared a secret weapon: perfect clones.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As conspiracies to gain political power abound, Paul's power base is eroded from within and his highly ambitious sister, Alia is gaining a political foothold. Born aware of her ancestral memories, Alia is considered an abomination by the Bene Gesserit. The Lady Jessica, her mother returns to Dune (Arrakis) to visit her grandchildren Leto II and Ghanima. When one particular ancestor begins to possess Alia, Lady Jessica has to take refuge. Leto II and Ghanima devise a plan toward salvation.

programme.title: Children Of Dune
programme.desc: As Alia becomes totally possessed she also has to deal with rebel Fremen. Ghanima, who survived an attack on her by House Corrino, is now engaged to Farad'n Corrino. Unexpectedly, Leto II returns from the desert being believed dead. While in the desert his body has absorbed some sand-trout, slowly mutating him into a sand-worm. Alia resists possession by the baron while Irulan declines Jessica's offer to return with her to Caladan.

programme.title: Son of the Dragon
programme.desc: " Devil Boy ", once foundling in the port of Shanghai , has become a avaontuurlijke young thief . He steals every street as he considers his family to be able to provide food . Now he has with his faithful companion Bird devised a cunning plan to steal the jewels of the royal palace . For this he needs to hand things from Li Wei, the daughter of the governor, where he immediately falls in love with . Coincidentally, Li Wei is just looking for a suitable marriage partner . But there is a lot of competition from the Prince from the North, which appear to be politically given the right choice for the governor. Li Wei, however, is charmed by Devil Boy and persuades her father to subdue her suitors to a series of difficult tests.

programme.title: Curling
programme.desc: Curling is an unique mix of shuffleboard and bowling on ice, with the strategy of chess thrown in for good measure, curling features two four-person teams who alternate sliding a large stone across the ice toward a bull's eye 126 feet away. Curling is not the easiest sport for the casual observer to try. Finding an ice rink, a 42-pound polished granite stone, and a set of brooms would pose a challenge for most of the people. Sportyfy helps curling enthusiasts to discover in depth this unusual ice sport by providing practical lessons and professional advises.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Fenerbahce" - "Olimpia Milano"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Real Madrid - Hapoel TA
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: From tree-climbing leopards to skull-crushing Jaguars, from fast-swimming fishing cats to quick-digging sand cats - watch the killer strategies that make wild cats possibly the deadliest family on the planet.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Big Cats V Prey. From elephants charging with lions clinging to their tusks, to turf wars between male leopards and hyenas driving a lion off his own buffalo kill, this epic safari reveals raw nature at its fiercest.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Barnstorming. The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Dr Oakley: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Spanning thousands of acres and incorporating hundreds of species of animals; Michelle Oakley's veterinary practice is Yukon tough. There is no such thing as a typical day in Michelle's practice. House calls can range from expelling dogs anal glands to getting chased down by the very large Arctic musk-ox. Accompanied by her teenage daughters and armed with humor as sharp as scalpel, Michelle deftly juggles being a full time Veterinarian, wife and doctor; taking us into unexplored and unexamined regions of the Yukon.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Snakes
programme.desc: Some strike without warning. Others move at blinding speed or attack in ways you never thought possible. Each possesses a special tactic that makes it a prime predator. Hidden weapons and startling skills. So watch out as the secret of snakes are revealed.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: Discover some of the most dangerous and deadly animal species on the planet, from big cats to tiny insects. These creatures developed amazing skills to survive and kill their pray in unique ways. Some of them use poison as their main weapon, while others are incredibly fast or camouflage well in order to catch their victims.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners

They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Pet's Peeved: The notorious Vesuvius Twins have adopted Skipper and King Julien and brought the animal's home to their luxury apartment. Not to spoil and pamper - but to fight each other over shiny baubles! The rest of the penguins and lemurs attempt a rescue but are captured themselves and made to perform in a painful "circus" the twins put together. The tables are going to need to be turned to get this circus out of town. Byte-Sized: Kowalski has another breakthrough invention, tiny robots that group together and not only fix broken tools and appliances, but run them as well. The penguins can just sit back and let the "Nanites" take care of all their chores! The problem is, the Nanites are programmed to protect the penguins at all costs, and ultimately seal the birds inside their lair. The only way to escape is to do battle with a giant, nasty, Nanite robot.".

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Hazel, Jasmine, and Winn take an online BFF compatibility test. To their surprise, they fail! Nobody is fazed, except for Hazel, who overthinks the results and wishes that her friends could know exactly what's in her head. Cosmo and Wanda grant the wish, which lands all of them inside Hazel's mind. As they go through her mind like a museum, Hazel continues to overthink everything they see. Now, Hazel must overcome her negative thoughts and battle a literal mind worm to get her friends out! // When Hazel wishes she didn't have a gap in her teeth, the Tooth Fairy fills her gap with a talking tooth, Toothica. At first, she seems like a lot of fun, but when Toothica gets Hazel in trouble with her parents and plans a party in Hazel's mouth Hazel isn't invited to, Hazel decides she wants her gone! The Tooth Fairy, however, takes Toothica's side and is even set on honoring her at a gala. Hazel must find a way to prove Toothica is no good and get back her gap or be stuck with this rotten tooth forever.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: After Hazel makes her one-millionth wish, Cosmo and Wanda promise her one rule-free wish as a reward. But when their magic doesn't work, they take a trip to Fairy World to investigate and discover Dev has taken control. Fed up with living in Hazel's shadow, he's teamed up with Irep to give control of the Big Wand to anti-fairies and now kids all over the world have the opportunity to grant wishes rule-free. Before Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda can stop Dev, he traps Cosmo and Wanda in butterfly net cages and sends Hazel back home without her fairies to help her. While in power, Dev changes Fairy World to his own image and liking, and even reveals the existence of magic to everyone on Earth. It's total chaos. With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Spongicus: Plankton has demolished the Chum Bucket! In its place, he has built a Roman coliseum and announces there will be a gladiator show, which means togas, chariots, and ferocious lionfish. And on top of all that, it's free! No one in Bikini Bottom can resist, not even Mr. Krabs! Suction Cup Symphony: The Bikini Bottom Symphony is accepting submissions for their composition contest, and Squidward is determined to win. He immediately gets to work on his masterpiece, but when SpongeBob and Patrick keep disrupting Squidward's concentration, it looks like they might ruin his chance at musical stardom.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Not Normal: When Squidward points out to SpongeBob that he's not normal, SpongeBob makes it his mission to become normal. SpongeBob begins to lose all his spongey-ness, and it's not long before he's completely unrecognizable, even to his best friends. Could this be the end of SpongeBob SquarePants as we know him? Gone: SpongeBob wakes up one morning to find that everyone in Bikini Bottom is gone - even Gary!

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Kowalski's obsession with Doris the dolphin drives him to invent a love ray, the Love-U-Laser. It works like a charm until Alice falls for a trashcan, Julien falls for Mort, and Skipper orders the ray to be put in reverse. Private gets hit by the reverse ray and instantly loathes Kowalski. Matters get much worse as the loathe ray explodes and everybody hates Kowalski! He's only got one shot to stop being the most loathed penguin in the world. // Told as a courtroom flashback, Kowalski unwisely revives Jiggles in a small, whipped cream-eating version. The little green cubes multiply on impact, however, and are soon threatening to cover the surface of the earth. As the Jiggli multiply out of control, will the team be able to prevent the jiggli-fication of the world?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Commissioner flips his lid, literally. His toupee blows off and sticks to Maurice, who also gets red cheeks and a skinned tail, all by accident. Julien and Mort chase him with sticks, intent on beating the "monster" stuck to Maurice's head. The baboon ladies take Maurice in, protecting and pampering him because they mistakenly think he's a male baboon. It's up to the penguins to get the toupee back and restore it to its rightful scalp. // Shelly the ostrich gets stuck in drying cement and only Rico can save her. Shelly falls for him hard as a result, however, Rico's heart forever belongs to his doll. Shelly swipes the doll and tries hard to win his heart, but Rico doesn't budge and his doll is accidently hauled off in a recycle truck. The penguins give chase but are left hopelessly in the dust. Shelly, wanting to make amends, tosses them on her back and sprints after the truck - can she possibly catch it?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When a young waterbender, named Katara, and her brother, Sokka, discover a giant iceberg while fishing for food around their homestead at the South Pole, they discover that there is a boy, named Aang, inside. Aang, they discover, is an airbender, (a group of people which were thought to be extinct). However, after a string of unfortunate events which puts the village in harm's way, they soon learn that there is more to him than meets the eye. Will Aang prove his hidden abilities, or will he be thought as just a child?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: A Life in a Day: Everyone is in awe of Larry the Lobster's daredevil ways, especially SpongeBob and Patrick. Patrick decides that it's time for them to start living like Larry, but SpongeBob isn't so sure. Sun Bleached: Everybody who's anybody is going to a big party in Bikini Bottom, but you have to be a certain shade of tan to get in. SpongeBob and Patrick decide to get tan so they can go to the party, but SpongeBob accidentally goes too far and turns sun-bleached white! Now, not only is he the wrong shade, but he can barely move without cracking and turning to dust.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. Leipcigo „LawnBallsport“ - Sinsheimo „Hoffenheim“

We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Lanso RC - Anžė SCO
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Le Mans '66 - La grande sfida
programme.desc: Due Oscar per il biopic di James Mangold con Christian Bale e Matt Damon, sulla storica sfida tra Ford e Ferrari. Carroll Shelby ha vinto la prestigiosa 24 Ore di Le Mans nel 1959 ma una patologia cardiaca gli proibisce di continuare a gareggiare. Si reinventa allora designer di automobili e accetta la proposta della Ford: progettare una macchina in grado di battere il bolide della Ferrari. Ma oltre al motore, per vincere serve anche un pilota super. E la scelta di Shelby ricade su Ken Miles, un intrepido e irascibile pilota britannico. Nel cast Remo Girone interpreta Enzo Ferrari.

programme.title: Elisa
programme.desc: Un criminologo segue il caso di Elisa, una donna di 35 anni rinchiusa in prigione da 10 anni per il barbaro omicidio apparentemente immotivato della sorella e per averne bruciato il cadavere. Sostiene di ricordare poco o niente del delitto.

programme.title: Lettere da Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Un Oscar e un Golden Globe alla pellicola di Clint Eastwood che, dopo "Flags of Our Fathers", torna ad affrontare la battaglia di Iwo Jima ma questa volta dal punto di vista giapponese.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano i più grandi successi del trio comico più amato d'Italia, disponibili su Sky Cinema e on demand.

programme.title: Radioactive
programme.desc: Rosamund Pike, Sam Riley e Anya Taylor-Joy nella biografia di Marie Curie. La vita della scienziata polacca, naturalizzata francese, che ha cambiato il mondo con le sue scoperte, salendo in cattedra in una società dominata dagli uomini e aggiudicandosi per due volte il Nobel.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al thriller diretto e interpretato da Ben Affleck. Iran, 1979: uno specialista della Cia attua un geniale piano per liberare un gruppo di ostaggi.

programme.title: We Are Marshall
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Charlie's Angels", un'emozionante storia vera con Matthew McConaughey. Dopo un tragico incidente, un allenatore fa di tutto per ricostruire la squadra di football.

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: A Los Angeles, il sensibile e solitario Theodore, uno scrittore di lettere d'amore, intraprende una relazione sentimentale con Samantha, il sistema operativo del suo computer dalla suadente voce femminile.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Dante
programme.desc: Biopic con Sergio Castellitto e Alessandro Sperduti, diretti da Pupi Avati. 30 anni dopo la morte di Dante Alighieri, il Boccaccio ne ripercorre la vita in un viaggio da Firenze e Ravenna.

programme.title: Il ciclone
programme.desc: In un paesino della Toscana vive la famiglia Quarini, il padre Osvaldo e i tre figli Levante, Libero e Selvaggia. Un giorno una compagnia spagnola di flamenco arriva e porta nuovo e contagioso entusiasmo nella vita dei quattro.

programme.title: Il sesso degli angeli
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni dirige e interpreta una commedia con Sabrina Ferilli e Marcello Fonte. Un sacerdote di Firenze scopre di aver ereditato una casa di appuntamenti in Svizzera.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: Un fantastico via vai
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni nel mondo dei 'laureati' in una commedia con Serena Autieri. Cacciato dalla moglie, un quarantenne si ritrova a condividere un appartamento con quattro studenti.

programme.title: Io & Marilyn
programme.desc: Durante una seduta spiritica Gualtiero evoca lo spirito di Marylin Monroe. L'attrice diventa una preziosa amica che lo aiuta a riconquistare sua moglie, scappata con un domatore di leoni.

programme.title: Se son rose
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni dirige e interpreta una commedia su un eterno Peter Pan. Un cinquantenne single e' costretto dalla figlia a riallacciare i contatti con tutte le sue ex.

programme.title: Fuochi d'artificio
programme.desc: Il trentenne Ottone conosce uno psicanalista alle Maldive e comincia ad assillarlo con domande pressanti sull'amore e sulle relazioni, con la speranza che lo psicanalista lo aiuti a fargli capire perché ha preso determinate decisioni.

programme.title: Ti amo in tutte le lingue del mondo
programme.desc: Gilberto è un felice professore di ginnastica tradito dalla moglie e tampinato da un'alunna che gli svela i suoi sentimenti in tutte le lingue del mondo.

programme.title: Il sesso degli angeli
programme.desc: Leonardo Pieraccioni dirige e interpreta una commedia con Sabrina Ferilli e Marcello Fonte. Un sacerdote di Firenze scopre di aver ereditato una casa di appuntamenti in Svizzera.

programme.title: Il pesce innamorato
programme.desc: Tante risate insieme a Leonardo Pieraccioni e Paolo Hendel in una spensierata commedia sentimentale. Arturo e' un falegname diventato famoso grazie a un libro di fiabe. Durante uno dei numerosi viaggi per la promozione del suo best-seller, vive una notte di passione con la bellissima Matilde (la modella Yamila Diaz). Successivamente, stufo del peso del successo, decide di ritirarsi in una casa di legno nel bosco. Ma Matilde si rifa' viva molti mesi piu' tardi, con un neonato in braccio. La reazione dubbiosa di Arturo la spinge a fuggire per sposarsi con un altro uomo...

programme.title: Il mistero della casa del tempo
programme.desc: Jack Black, Cate Blanchett e Kyle MacLachlan in un intrigante fantasy di Eli Roth. L'orfanello Lewis si trasferisce a casa dell'eccentrico zio, scoprendo un mondo di incantesimi e streghe.

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo

programme.desc: Terzo capitolo con Will Smith e Tommy Lee Jones, protettori del pianeta dagli alieni. L’agente J viaggia nel tempo fino al 1969 per modificare il passato e salvare la vita al collega K.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Carlo Lavagna dirige un thriller ambientato nel buio dei boschi. Una madre severa costringe le figlie a vivere da recluse in un hotel abbandonato per proteggerle da una scioccante verita'.

programme.title: The Lodge
programme.desc: Riley Keough in un horror carico di misteri. Durante una bufera, due fratellini rimangono intrappolati in uno chalet con la fidanzata del padre, donna dall'ambiguo passato.

programme.title: Sabotatori
programme.desc: Spy-thriller bellico di Alfred Hitchcock. Alla vigilia della 2a guerra mondiale, un operaio viene accusato di sabotaggio. Per provare la sua innocenza dovrà scoprire i veri colpevoli.

programme.title: Drop: Accetta o rifiuta
programme.desc: Una donna accetta un appuntamento romantico, ma la serata sprofonda nell'incubo quando un anonimo criminale comincia a perseguitarla: sul suo smartphone arrivano messaggi sempre piu' minacciosi e un terrificante ricatto a cui lei non puo' sottrarsi.

programme.title: Sotto il segno del pericolo
programme.desc: Ritorna Harrison Ford nei panni di Jack Ryan nel terzo film dai romanzi di spionaggio di Tom Clancy. L'agente sfida una banda di narcotrafficanti colombiani protetti dal governo americano.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Thriller psicologico con Sarah Paulson e Keira Allen. Costretta su una sedia a rotelle, la giovane Chloe scopre che le amorevoli cure di sua madre nascondono una verita' inaspettata.

programme.title: Caccia al killer: Ted Bundy
programme.desc: Daniel Farrands dirige un thriller biografico con Chad Michael Murray, Holland Roden e Lin Shaye. Anni 70: l'FBI da' la caccia a uno dei piu' feroci serial killer d'America: Ted Bundy.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky tratto dall'omonima graphic novel. Sola nel deserto, una donna deve liberare il figlio intrappolato in una macchina blindata.

programme.desc: Eric Bana nel thriller tratto dal romanzo di Jane Harper. Non convinto dalla versione ufficiale dei fatti, un poliziotto torna nella sua citta' per indagare sul suicidio di un amico.

programme.title: Il settimo giorno
programme.desc: Guy Pearce e Stephen Lang in un horror satanico. Un esperto esorcista conduce un giovane sacerdote nel mondo delle possessioni demoniache in un terrificante percorso di iniziazione.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: Crime-thriller con Frank Grillo, Josh Hartnett e Melissa Leo. In prigione per omicidio, la matriarca di una famiglia del crimine tesse le fila della malavita dal carcere.

programme.desc: Liam Hemsworth e Dwayne Johnson in un action senza respiro, tratto da una storia vera. Due giovani immigrati greci mettono a segno un colpo milionario, ma un detective è sulle loro tracce.

programme.desc: Kevin Costner nella rievocazione dei 13 giorni più delicati della presidenza Kennedy. 1962: l'installazione di missili sovietici a Cuba rischia di far esplodere la Terza guerra mondiale.

programme.title: L'uomo di neve
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di Jo Nesbo, un thriller con Michael Fassbender, Rebecca Ferguson e Charlotte Gainsbourg, diretto dal regista de "La talpa". Durante l'inverno norvegese, il detective Harry Hole indaga sulla morte di una donna, uccisa nel corso della prima nevicata della stagione. Hole e' convinto che l'omicidio sia legato ad altri delitti avvenuti in passato. In ballo c'e' dunque un serial killer da fermare e l'unico modo per evitare che uccida ancora e' prevenirne le prossime mosse. "L'uomo di neve' e' il settimo romanzo dedicato al detective Harry Hole, il primo adattato per il cinema.

programme.desc: Dopo aver compiuto un omicidio due amici danno una cena sicuri di non venire scoperti. Ma tra gli invitati qualcuno sospetta di loro. Straordinario esercizio di stile del re del brivido: un film girato in un unico piano sequenza.

Dan Gallagher, un avvocato di New York felicemente sposato, tradisce la moglie con una sconosciuta, che non si accontenta di una sola notte e comincia a perseguitarlo rendendogli la vita un inferno. Le provocazioni della psicopatica si fanno sempre piu' asfissianti, fino a quando la donna comunica a Dan di essere incinta, rifiutandosi di abortire. La sua prossima sfida sara' recarsi a casa dell'uomo per conoscere la moglie...

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original - di Peter Chelsom e con Marco D'Amore - sui torbidi segreti di una nota località turistica versiliese.

programme.title: Ex - Amici come prima!

Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Ghostbusters" una commedia piccante con due sex symbol di Hollywood, Natalie Portman e Ashton Kutcher. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi e Micaela Ramazzotti in una commedia romantica di Cristina Comencini. Due amiche di vecchia data, e molto diverse tra loro, si contendono l’amore per uno sconosciuto.

programme.desc: Romantica commedia natalizia con Denise Richards e Patrick Muldoon. Alla vigilia di Natale, Amy scopre di dover gestire insieme al suo ex fidanzato una panetteria ricevuta in eredita'.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: Se scappi, ti sposo
programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Richard Gere di nuovo insieme nella commedia romantica dal regista di "Pretty Woman". Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.title: Proposta indecente

Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.desc: Tornano i moschettieri Pierfrancesco Favino, Valerio Mastandrea, Rocco Papaleo, assieme alla regina Margherita Buy, diretti da Giovanni Veronesi nel primo film targato Sky Original.

programme.title: Uno di famiglia
programme.desc: Ironica commedia sull'Italia di oggi con Pietro Sermonti, Nino Frassica e Lucia Ocone. Un insegnante di dizione salva la vita a uno studente che appartiene a una famiglia di malavitosi.

programme.title: Compromessi sposi
programme.desc: Diego Abatantuono e Vincenzo Salemme in una commedia di Francesco Micciche'. Un imprenditore del Nord e un sindaco del Sud si alleano per impedire le nozze dei rispettivi figli.

programme.title: D.N.A. - Decisamente Non Adatti
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Lillo & Greg, star di una commedia degli equivoci con Anna Foglietta e Francesco Mura. Due ex compagni di scuola decidono di scambiarsi i rispettivi codici genetici.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La girata
programme.desc: Nuove indagini nel 23esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Durante una battuta di caccia tra amici ci scappa il morto. Un incidente? Solo la Fusco e Massimo sapranno darci una risposta.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da favola
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Adriano Giannini e Ricky Memphis. Un gruppo di amici del liceo si ritrova dopo 20 anni in occasione di un matrimonio. Faranno un bilancio delle loro vite.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni 2
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Joker", Bradley Cooper nel celebre sequel di sbornie e avventura. Riunitasi in Thailandia per le nozze di Stu, la gang si ritrova catapultata in una spirale di disastri.

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Qualunquemente
programme.desc: Antonio Albanese nei panni dello spassoso Cetto La Qualunque. Tornato in Italia dopo un periodo di latitanza, Cetto si candida a sindaco per difendere le sue proprieta' dalla... legalita'.

programme.title: Il premio
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann dirige e interpreta una commedia con Gigi Proietti, Rocco Papaleo, Anna Foglietta. Uno scrittore con la paura di volare raggiunge Stoccolma in auto per ritirare il Nobel.

programme.title: Una notte da leoni 3
programme.desc: Torna Bradley Cooper con i suoi pazzi compagni di avventura in un'altra folle notte. Il quartetto di amici finisce in un vortice di incredibili imprevisti dopo un inaspettato sequestro.

programme.title: Scuola di polizia
programme.desc: Cult della commedia demenziale anni 80 con Steve Guttenberg e Kim Cattrall. La libera iscrizione richiama all'accademia di polizia una serie di improbabili e catastrofici personaggi.

programme.title: Insospettabili sospetti
programme.desc: Colpo grosso in grande stile in una commedia con Morgan Freeman, Michael Caine e Alan Arkin. Tre amici di lunga data scoprono che i loro fondi pensione sono andati in fumo.

programme.title: La casa di famiglia
programme.desc: Stefano Fresi, Matilde Gioli, Libero De Rienzo e Lino Guanciale in una commedia degli equivoci. Venduta la tenuta di famiglia, 4 fratelli devono ripensarci quando il padre esce dal coma.

programme.desc: Graffiante commedia con Michele Placido, Alessandro Gassmann, Raoul Bova e Ambra Angiolini. Colpito da improvvisa demenza, un senatore perde ogni inibizione e non riesce più a mentire.

programme.title: Sconnessi
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Ricky Memphis, Carolina Crescentini e Stefano Fresi. I componenti di una famiglia entrano in crisi quando si ritrovano in una baita senza internet.

programme.title: The Parenting
programme.desc: Brian Cox e Lisa Kudrow in una commedia a tinte horror. Una coppia organizza un weekend per presentare i genitori, ma la casa in affitto è infestata da un poltergeist.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Sopra la panca
programme.desc: 24esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original con i protagonisti del BarLume. Mentre il padre di Tiziana sparisce all'improvviso, un cadavere trovato in mare fa partire una nuova indagine.

programme.title: Ocean's 8
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Cate Blanchett, Anne Hathaway e Rihanna in un'action-comedy dal regista di "Hunger Games'. Dopo cinque anni in carcere a preparare il colpo perfetto, Debbie Ocean passa all'azione e raduna una squadra di rapinatrici: vuole approfittare di una festa da ballo per rubare una collana di diamanti del valore di 150 milioni di dollari custodita all'interno del Metropolitan Museum di New York. Sequel in versione femminile della trilogia formata da "Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco', "Ocean's Twelve' e "Ocean's Thirteen', diretta da Steven Soderbergh, qui in veste di produttore.

programme.title: Ti ripresento i tuoi
programme.desc: Il regista di "Giu' al Nord", Dany Boon dirige e interpreta una commedia degli equivoci. Un architetto nasconde le sue umili origini, ma un giorno i suoi genitori si presentano a Parigi.

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

programme.title: Breaking News a Yuba County
programme.desc: Black-comedy Sky Original con il premio Oscar Allison Janney e Mila Kunis. Quando il marito scompare, Sue finisce sotto i riflettori. Ora tutti vogliono sapere che fine ha fatto l'uomo.

As their wedding approaches, his parents try to sabotage his future while Young-hee investigates a serial murder case, and Chul-soo uses his family's skills to help.

programme.title: The Snitch

programme.title: Daddy O, Baby O
programme.desc: A middle aged bachelor Mario spent his life taking care of his eccentric sister Brenda. He sells goodies in a mobile cart for a living. His daily routine gets a sudden turnaround when his dying friend Arnold made him promise to take care of his daughter Ana. But Ana is not just an ordinary little girl, despite her angelic look; she is cunning and mischievous who is in search of her estranged mother. Mario and Ana agreed that they would earn money to look for Ana’s mother in Cebu, but Ana should tame down. Mario performs his new task as a father to the orphan child in a very unconventional way. But through the help of a beautiful teacher named Maribel, he would always keep things going.

programme.desc: The film centers on a terminally ill man who sets up his best friend, whom he has loved since high school, so that she will not be lonely after he passes away.

programme.title: Nuuk
programme.desc: Elaisa is a middle-aged Filipino widow who lives in Nuuk with her rebellious adult son Karl. She meets Mark Alvarez, a visiting Filipino seaman. He is friendly and caring. But a blizzard is threatening to cause more havoc in her life.

programme.title: Nanay, Tatay
programme.desc: Three orphans, Olive, Paula, and Bettina, escape captivity and are adopted by Amanda and Lito, who lost their daughter, Malena. The orphans discover that Malena, now possessed by a demon due to her parents' pact, is imprisoned in the stockroom. As Malena hunts them down, the orphans are coerced into robbing the couple. The conflict leads to several deaths, including the couple's. Olive and Bettina escape, promising to care for each other.

programme.title: Smallville S2 13
programme.desc: After Lionel is shot, Jonathan is arrested. But Clark and Pete perform their own crime scene investigation and uncover other suspects.

programme.title: Smallville S2 14
programme.desc: After a parasitic worm infects Pete and Chloe, they become thrill-seeking daredevils, and Pete uses red meteor rocks to persuade Clark to join them on a dangerous adventure.

programme.title: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: In CLASH OF THE TITANS, the ultimate struggle for power pits men against kings and kings against gods. But the war between the gods themselves could destroy the world. Sam Worthington (Terminator Salvation, Avatar) stars as the Greek hero Perseus in this spectacular retelling of the classic myth (and '80s cult classic film). Born of a god, but raised as a man, Perseus is helpless to save his family from the clutches of Hades (Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes -- Harry Potter films), the vengeful god of the underworld. With nothing left to lose, he volunteers to lead a dangerous mission to defeat Hades before he can seize power from Zeus (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson -- Batman Begins) and unleash hell on earth. With a daring band of warriors, Perseus sets off on a perilous journey deep into forbidden worlds. Battling unholy demons and fearsome beasts, he will triumph only if he can accept his power as a god, defy his fate and create his own destiny.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: Taking place 10 years after his heroic defeat of the Kraken, Perseus (Sam Worthington) embarks on a treacherous quest into the underworld to rescue his father, overthrow the Titans and save mankind.

programme.title: Friends S6 17
programme.desc: Chandler and Monica agree to give each other homemade presents for their six-month anniversary.

programme.title: Friends S6 18
programme.desc: When a fire damages their apartment, Rachel and Phoebe must choose between living temporarily with Joey or Monica. Ross gets into trouble by dating a student. Chandler tries to help Joey's career.

programme.title: Friends S6 19
programme.desc: Ross worries when his student/girlfriend goes on vacation with her wild friends. Rachel needs a date for a ball. Joey's refrigerator breaks down.

programme.title: Friends S6 20
programme.desc: In this episode primarily composed of clips from earlier shows, Joey auditions for a major television role. But Chandler almost ruins everything by forgetting a telephone message.

programme.title: The Legend Of Tarzan (2016)
programme.desc: A new live-action adventure from director David Yates (Harry Potter films) brings Edgar Rice Burroughs' legendary character back to the big screen. It's been years since the man once known as Tarzan (Alexander Skarsgard --True Blood) left the jungles of Africa behind for a gentrified life as John Clayton III, Lord Greystoke, with his beloved wife, Jane (Margot Robbie --The Wolf of Wall Street) at his side. Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). But those behind the murderous plot have no idea what they are about to unleash.

programme.title: Jack The Giant SlayER
programme.desc: Bryan Singer supersizes the \"Jack and the Beanstalk\" legend in this epic action twist on a classic tale, starring Nicholas Hoult, Stanley Tucci, Bill Nighy, Ewan McGregor, Ian McShane and more. When a young farmhand unwittingly opens a gateway between our world and a fearsome race of giants, an ancient war is reignited. Unleashed upon the Earth, the marauding giants strive to reclaim the land they once lost, forcing Jack into the battle of his life to stop them. Fighting for a kingdom and its people -- and the love of a princess, of course -- he comes face to face with the legendary goliaths and, in the process, become a legend himself.

programme.title: Dunkirk (2017)
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Christopher Nolan writes, directs and produces this wartime epic action thriller. Dunkirk opens as hundreds of thousands of British and Allied troops find themselves surrounded by enemy forces in the Northern French City during 1940 World War II. Trapped on the beach with the sea at their backs, they face an impossible situation as the German troops close in. The story unfolds on land, sea and air. RAF Spitfires engage the enemy in the skies above the Channel, trying to protect the defenseless men below. Meanwhile, a quickly assembled British fleet led the legendary evacuation of over 300,000 Allied military forces in what Prime Minister Winston Churchill would call a \"miracle of deliverance.\".

programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro (Pan's Labyrinth) brings out the big guns in this sci-fi action epic about a ragtag band of humans that band together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea. Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors (including Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day \u0026 Rinko Kikuchi) take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

programme.title: The Wrong Man
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Henry Fonda stars in director Alfred Hitchcock's real-life thriller of an innocent man trapped as the victim of a heartless criminal justice system--even though he's The Wrong Man. When an eyewitness to a robbery identifies musician Christopher Balestrero (Fonda) as the culprit, Balestrero cannot prove where he was on the day of the crime. Now, the wheels of justice--driven by the testimony of witnesses--mercilessly grind away the life of a man who looks remarkably like the real thief. Based on the novel The True Story of Christopher Emmanuel Balestrero by Maxwell Anderson.
